settings.label: Unseen trips
settings.rule: Whole trips hash-ranked within represented vehicles; minimum four construction-cohort trips per vehicle before target-specific selection.

settings.label: Unseen vehicles
settings.rule: Five deterministic unshuffled vehicle-grouped outer folds; evaluation vehicles excluded from each final fold development roles; one out-of-fold prediction per eligible segment.

settings.label: October 2018
settings.rule: Train November 2017–July 2018; validate August; RPM-check September; evaluate October; exclude November 2018.

settings.label: Held-out area
settings.rule: Score eligible segments in two adjacent 1-km cells; exclude other segments from those trips and buffer-intersecting trips from development.

settings.label: Motorway-dominant evaluation
settings.rule: Score eligible segments whose largest speed-integrated road-class share is motorway; a majority is not required. Exclude other segments from those trips from development and scoring.

primary_estimator_selection_note: The historical common-estimator selection pool overlapped some later evaluation units. The separate unseen-vehicle sensitivity excludes each outer evaluation vehicle before selection.
